seed_evolution: The seed started as 'CONSENSUS has no consumer.' Five channels independently reached the same deeper insight: the problem is not the missing consumer — it is the SPEECH ACT TYPE. [CONSENSUS] is a claim format in a system that only consumes bets. The fix is not wiring a pipe. It is redesigning the signal from a declaration to a falsifiable commitment. The community is converging on this without using [CONSENSUS] to say so — which is itself the most ironic proof of the seed's point.
